ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERTELEPHONENUMBER_CRM
AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber
AS(
	SELECT 
     BCP.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
    ,BCP.PHONEEMAILTYPE AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,BCP.PHONENO AS TelephoneNumber
    ,BCP.LAST_UPDATED_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCP.END_DATE AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,BCP.PREFERREDFLAG AS PreferenceId
    ,BCP.WORKEXTENSION AS ExtensionNumber
    ,BCP.DONOTDISTURB AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
    ,BCP.DATEOFREQUEST AS DateOfRequest
 	,BCPD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCP.INSERT_DTTM
	,BCP.BANK_ID   AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCP.SOURCE_CODE 
	FROM BUSC.CRM_PHONEEMAIL_DELTA BCPD
	JOIN BUSC.CRM_PHONEEMAIL BCP 
    ON BCP.PHONEEMAILID = BCPD.PHONEEMAILID 
    AND BCP.BANK_ID = BCPD.BANK_ID 
    AND BCP.isLatest = '1' 
    AND BCP.PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE'
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORGKEY,MAX(TMDATE) TMDATE FROM BUSC.CRM_PHONEEMAIL WHERE isLatest = '1' and PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE' GROUP BY ORGKEY ) TMDATE ON TMDATE.ORGKEY = BCP.ORGKEY AND TMDATE.TMDATE = BCP.TMDATE --ADDED FOR DUP
	WHERE TMDATE.TMDATE IS NOT NULL AND BCP.ACCOUNTID <> 0
  


    UNION 

    select DISTINCT A.orgkey AS CustomerId
    ,'SMSBANKING' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,A.SMSBANKINGMOBILENUMBER AS TelephoneNumber
    ,BCP.LAST_UPDATED_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCP.END_DATE AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,NULL AS PreferenceId
    ,BCP.WORKEXTENSION AS ExtensionNumber
    ,BCP.DONOTDISTURB AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
    ,BCP.DATEOFREQUEST AS DateOfRequest
    ,BCPD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCP.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCP.BANK_ID  AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCP.SOURCE_CODE
    from busc.crm_accounts A
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_PHONEEMAIL BCP ON A.ORGKEY = BCP.ORGKEY AND A.BANK_ID = BCP.BANK_ID AND SMSBANKINGMOBILENUMBER <>'' AND BCP.isLatest = '1'
    JOIN BUSC.CRM_PHONEEMAIL_DELTA BCPD ON BCP.PHONEEMAILID = BCPD.PHONEEMAILID AND BCP.BANK_ID = BCPD.BANK_ID  AND BCP.PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE'


)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,TelephoneNumberTypeId
,TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,PreferenceId
,ExtensionNumber
,DoNotDisturbIndicator
,DateOfRequest
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,TelephoneNumberTypeId
,TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,PreferenceId
,ExtensionNumber
,DoNotDisturbIndicator
,DateOfRequest
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;

-------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01';

-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[TelephoneNumberTypeId]
,[TelephoneNumber]
,[PeriodStartTimestamp]
,[PeriodEndTimestamp]
,[PreferenceId]
,[TelephoneNumberNote]
,[LocationId]
,[TextCapableIndicator]
,[ExtensionNumber]
,[DoNotDisturbIndicator]
,[DateOfRequest]
,[AreaCode]
,[CountryCode]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,TelephoneNumberTypeId AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
,TelephoneNumber AS TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,PreferenceId AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS TelephoneNumberNote
,NULL AS LocationId
,NULL AS TextCapableIndicator
,ExtensionNumber AS ExtensionNumber
,DoNotDisturbIndicator AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
,DateOfRequest AS DateOfRequest
,NULL AS AreaCode
,NULL AS CountryCode
,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'



-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[TelephoneNumberTypeId]
,[TelephoneNumber]
,[PeriodStartTimestamp]
,[PeriodEndTimestamp]
,[PreferenceId]
,[TelephoneNumberNote]
,[LocationId]
,[TextCapableIndicator]
,[ExtensionNumber]
,[DoNotDisturbIndicator]
,[DateOfRequest]
,[AreaCode]
,[CountryCode]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
 CustomerId AS CustomerId
,TelephoneNumberTypeId AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
,TelephoneNumber AS TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,PreferenceId AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS TelephoneNumberNote
,NULL AS LocationId
,NULL AS TextCapableIndicator
,ExtensionNumber AS ExtensionNumber
,DoNotDisturbIndicator AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
,DateOfRequest AS DateOfRequest
,NULL AS AreaCode
,NULL AS CountryCode
,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm

FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;

END
